title: User-Driven Value Alignment: Understanding Users’ Perceptions and Strategies for Addressing Biased and Discriminatory Statements in AI Companions
reasoning: The paper's primary focus is on 'user-driven value alignment,' which explores how users identify, challenge, and correct AI outputs based on their own moral values and ethical standards. It evaluates the strategies users use to align AI companions with human-centric ethics, specifically addressing discriminatory and harmful behaviors.
